title: Marrying childhood sweetheart Gene Hitchens
summary: His first wife, married in 1944 when he was 19; attitudes toward marriage.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah. But I wouldn't go out by myself. My mother would be with me. She wouldn't let us out of our sight on Mardi Grotti. And a lot of times, a lot of places I went to, when it was Mardi Grotti, I never would've gone there without my trumpet. Now like when I had my little girlfriend and I wanted to see her, I would lie and tell my mother I had a job to play. Take my trumpet out. What? My childhood sweetheart. What was her name? Gene. Gene Hitchens. Gene Hitchens. And when I was in the Navy, I came home on leave one time and we got married. When was that? Do you remember the date? I forgot the date, but the year was 1944. Yeah. Then we divorced. Both of us got married again. But we were the best of friends and we still go to the same church. We'd sit down and laugh and joke about the things we used to do. We used to cheat on each other. We were the best of friends. And Buffer would say if we hadn't known then, like we know now, we would joke right together. See, I had the wrong idea about marriage. I thought when you marry a woman that was your property, your owner. Well a lot of people, that's the way it was a long time ago. But like now, these women, they want to do their thing. And if you don't want to put up with it, she'll devotion and take everything you have.
So Gene wasn't like that? She wanted to have her own life?
No, but see, I used to, see I thought that when you marry a woman you owned her. I thought I owned her. But she thought she owned me too. Well, that's.
But we. You were pretty young then too.
Oh yeah, I was 19 years old when I married her and she was 18.
That can be a problem too.
But we started going together when she was 13 and I was 14. And man, I thought there was no woman in the world as pretty as she was. I had a question about Tits Washington.
